outputs.intent: Cover Flow album-selection concept based on native screenshot; fictional media, not a real library or playback result
outputs.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create ONE simple HomePad album-selection / Cover Flow CONCEPT effect image to join the existing set, edge-to-edge landscape at approximately 1512x1040, with no added marketing text. Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the actual native HomePad Cover Flow screenshot. It is stored with EXIF rotation; treat it as the LANDSCAPE UI shown in conversation. Preserve its exact screen layout: top-left Now playing back control, top-right AirPlay and volume pill, more button and Pages; the central selected square album with two perspective-tilted side album covers; left/right chevrons beside album metadata; View album and search controls; existing small native instruction; and the full-width bottom mini player with TEST DATA badge beneath it. Input 2 is the already approved HomePad music effect image: use it to MATCH the warm brown / amber soft-focus backdrop, thin white controls, media identity and photographic artwork style. Inputs 3 and 4 are licensed real photographic assets. Replace the central generic music-note album placeholder with the mountain/lake photo from input 3, using the same square photo composition as the cover in input 2. Replace the left angled placeholder with a photographic cover cropped from the sunlit living room in input 4, and the right angled placeholder with a different close crop of autumn forest / lake reflections from input 3. These three covers should be visibly distinct, fill the existing cover planes cleanly, have gently rounded corners and respect the original native Cover Flow perspective. Do not add typography or fake musician logos to the covers. Change selected album metadata to the fictional album name 'First Light' and artist 'HomePad Demo'. Keep original metadata positions and restrained text size. Populate the bottom mini player with the same small mountain artwork, 'First Light' and 'HomePad Demo', and a white PAUSE symbol to match the illustrative playing state in input 2. Keep its TEST DATA pill legible and visible. All textual elements must remain native UI, with no title, description, labels, frame, page number, brand bar or footer outside the app. No physical device or room mockup. Do not redesign navigation, invent controls, add song lists, queue badges or overlay popups. This is an illustrative concept using fictional music, not real Apple Music account content or proof of playback. Keep the three cover faces sharp and appealing, the rest of the screen quiet, and geometry faithful to input 1.
